source: Controlled metadata fixtures generated by scripts/acceptance/cases/FT-019.py; no audio was downloaded.
manual_method: Labels were checked against the explicit artist MBID, album, year, ordered track count/positions/titles and available durations. Unknown identity/year and conflicting metadata are not positive links.

choices.same_edition: one uniquely supported underlying studio album edition with compatible metadata.
choices.different: disproved match or missing mandatory evidence, so the candidate is not safe to auto-link.
choices.ambiguous: multiple equally plausible candidates prevent choosing one release.
